blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative four times the quantity negative two x plus three.
Negative four multiplies both terms: negative four times negative two x, plus negative four times three.
A negative times a negative is positive, so the first part is eight x. Negative four times three is negative twelve.
So the answer is eight x minus twelve.
Watch out for these traps. If you keep the first term negative, you get negative eight x minus twelve. If you make both terms positive, you get eight x plus twelve.
